Warm-up · 热身

Add or multiply?加同一个数，还是乘同一个数？

Linear adds the same amount; exponential multiplies by the same factor. 线性加，指数乘。

A population of 1,000 doubles every year.
What is the population after 3 years?
A quantity grows by 5% each year.
By what factor is it multiplied each year?
Concept

Linear vs exponential · 线性与指数的区别

Two savings plans 两种存钱方案

Both start with $100.

Year0123Pattern
Plan A: +$10 each year100110120130add 10 → linear
Plan B: +10% each year100110121133.1× 1.1 → exponential
  • Plan B, year 2: 10% of 110 is 11, so 110 + 11 = 121 — the same as 110 × 1.1.
  • Linear: y = 100 + 10t. Exponential: y = 100(1.1)t.
  • Same amount each step → linear. Same percent (same factor) each step → exponential.

每次加同样的数 → 线性；每次乘同样的数（按同样的百分比变化）→ 指数。指数增长一开始慢，后来越来越快。

Vocabulary 词汇

exponential growth / decay指数增长 / 指数衰减
initial value a初始值（t = 0 时的值）
growth / decay factor b增长 / 衰减因子：每一步乘的数
rate (percent)增长率：1.1 对应 10%
base, exponent25：底数 2，指数 5
double / halve翻倍（× 2）/ 减半（× 0.5）
half-life半衰期：减到一半所需时间

记住：b0 = 1，所以 f(0) = a，初始值就是图像的 y 轴截距。

Concept

Building f(t) = a(b)t from words · 从文字写出指数模型

Step by step 分步

A town has 2,000 people and grows by 5% per year.

  1. Start value: a = 2,000.
  2. Factor: grow 5% → keep 100% and add 5% → b = 1 + 0.05 = 1.05.
  3. Model: P(t) = 2,000(1.05)t.
  4. After 2 years: 2,000 × 1.052 = 2,000 × 1.1025 = 2,205.

A car worth $20,000 loses 15% of its value each year → b = 1 − 0.15 = 0.85 → V(t) = 20,000(0.85)t. After 1 year: $17,000.

增长 p% → 乘 (1 + p%)；减少 p% → 乘 (1 − p%)。初始值放前面，因子做底数，时间做指数。

Percent ↔ factor 百分比与因子

WordsFactor b
increase 5%1.05
increase 0.49%1.0049
decrease 15%0.85
decrease 2%0.98
doubles / halves2 / 0.5

❌ grows 5% → b = 1.51.5 means +50%. 5% → 1.05.

❌ decreases 15% → b = 0.150.15 keeps only 15%. Use 0.85. 剩下 85%。

b > 1 增长，0 < b < 1 衰减。看因子反推百分比：0.92 → 减少 8%。

Concept

Time in the exponent · 指数里的时间单位

“Doubles every 3 hours” 每 3 小时翻倍

100 cells; the number doubles every 3 hours.

t (hours)0369
doublings0123
cells100200400800

Number of doublings = t3, so N(t) = 100 · 2t/3. Check: t = 6 → 100 · 22 = 400 ✓

先算“翻倍了几次”= 总时间 ÷ 每次所需时间，这个次数就是指数。

Changing units 换时间单位

V = 500(1.06)t with t in years. Write it with m = months.

  1. 12 months = 1 year, so t = m12.
  2. V = 500(1.06)m/12.
  3. Check: m = 12 → 500(1.06)1 ✓

❌ 15 hours, doubles every 3 hours → × 2 × 15Not ×15 or ×30: it doubles 153 = 5 times → × 25 = × 32.

“每 3 小时”→ 指数写 t/3；年换成月 → t = m/12。代入一个简单值验算。

Key facts

Reading an exponential model读懂指数模型

Form
指数模型
f(t) = a · bt
a 是初始量，b 是每一步的倍率。例：100 × 1.1ᵗ，每一步乘 1.1。
Starting value
初始值
a = f(0): the y-intercept (0, a)
t = 0 时 b⁰ = 1。例：500 × 0.8ᵗ 的初始量为 500。
Growth factor b > 1
增长倍率
increases by (b − 1) × 100% each step: 1.06 → 6%
例：每年增长 6%，一年乘 1.06；两年乘 1.06²。此处假设初始量为正。
Decay factor 0 < b < 1
衰减倍率
decreases by (1 − b) × 100%: 0.64 → 36%
例：每年减少 20%，保留 80%，倍率是 0.8，而不是 0.2。
“p% more than”
增加百分之几
factor 1 + p100: 150% more → 2.5; 190% more → 2.9
“增加 150%”表示原量加 1.5 倍原量，共 2.5 倍。
Doubling / halving
倍增／减半周期
a(2)t/d: doubles every d units; a(12)t/d: halves
例：80 × 2 的 t/3 次方，每 3 小时翻倍；t = 6 时为 320。
Changing units
时间单位换算
years → months: replace t with m12
例：年增长模型 100 × 1.12ᵗ；m 个月对应 t = m/12 年。
Linear vs exponential
固定差与固定比
constant difference → linear; constant ratio → exponential
10、15、20 每次加 5：线性；10、20、40 每次乘 2：指数。

Exponent t410: the factor 2 is applied once every 410 minutes, so the population doubles every 410 minutes. 指数是 t/410：每 410 分钟乘一次 2。

How to approach it

Steps for building or reading a model

1

Find the starting value a

The value when t = 0. If you are given a later value, work backward: divide by the factor. 找初始值；若给的是后面的值，就除以因子倒推。

2

Turn the percent into a factor b

Increase by p% → 1 + p/100. Decrease by p% → 1 − p/100. 百分比 → 增长/衰减因子。

3

Check the time unit in the exponent

Every 3 hours → t/3. Per year but t in months → m/12. 核对指数里的时间单位。

Desmos: type the model, e.g. y=72(2.5)^x, and check known points such as (1, 180). To compare two forms, graph both: equivalent forms give one curve. Desmos：画出模型，检查已知点；等价形式图像重合。

Example 1

Form 1 · Math Module 2 · Question 25

Form 1 · Math Module 2 · Question 25

先自己想 1–2 分钟，再点开完整解析。

Idea · 思路

Turn “150% more” into a factor, then use the 2016 value to find a (the 2015 value).

先求因子，再由 2016 年的值倒推 2015 年。

Solution · 解析

  1. Growth factor: 150% more → 1 + 1.50 = 2.5 (not 1.5).
  2. Locate 2016: End of 2016 is t = 1: n(1) = a(2.5) = 180.
  3. Starting value: a = 1802.5 = 72 (squirrels at the end of 2015).
  4. Model: n = 72(2.5)t
Desmos · 图形计算器
1y=72(2.5)^x
2y=180(2.5)^x
3(1,180)

The curve passes through (1, 180), and its y-intercept is 72.

Why not the others · 错误选项

A ✗ Right start, but 150% more means × 2.5, not × 1.5.
C ✗ Wrong factor, and 180 is the value at t = 1, not t = 0.
D ✗ Right factor, but n(0) = 180 puts 180 at the end of 2015.

Answer: B. n = 72(2.5)t Takeaway. “p% more” → factor 1 + p/100. The coefficient must be the value at t = 0. “多 p%”→ 1 + p/100；系数是 t = 0 时的值。

Example 2

Form 1 · Math Module 2 · Question 15

Form 1 · Math Module 2 · Question 15

先自己想 1–2 分钟，再点开完整解析。

Idea · 思路

What is E(0)?

Solution · 解析

  1. E(0) = 5(1.8)0 = 5.
  2. 5 = the estimated number of employees when the restaurant opened (t = 0).
系数 = t = 0 时的值。

Why not the others · 错误选项

B ✗ The yearly change is not a fixed amount; the factor 1.8 means an 80% increase.
C ✗ The number of years is t.
D ✗ The percent increase is 80%, from the 1.8.

Answer: A.

Example 3

Form 1 · Math Module 2 · Question 17

Form 1 · Math Module 2 · Question 17

先自己想 1–2 分钟，再点开完整解析。

Idea · 思路

Is 0.49% of the previous value a fixed amount or a fixed percent?

Solution · 解析

  1. Each year the value is multiplied by 1.0049: a constant percent → exponential.
  2. The value increases → increasing exponential.
按固定百分比增长 → 指数增长。

Why not the others · 错误选项

A ✗ The value grows, it does not decrease.
B ✗ It grows, and by a percent, not a fixed amount.
D ✗ A fixed amount each year would be linear; this is a fixed percent.

Answer: C.

Example 4

Form 4 · Math Module 2 · Question 23

Form 4 · Math Module 2 · Question 23

先自己想 1–2 分钟，再点开完整解析。

Idea · 思路

In one year, x = 12 months. What is the factor per year?

Solution · 解析

  1. When x increases by 12, the exponent x12 increases by 1 → the value is multiplied by 0.64.
  2. 0.64 = 1 − 0.36 → a 36% decrease per year.
每 12 个月乘一次 0.64 → 每年减少 36%。

Why not the others · 错误选项

A ✗ 4 may come from a calculation error.
B ✗ 5 is about 64 ÷ 12: dividing by 12 does not give the yearly change.
D ✗ 64% is what remains, not the decrease.

Answer: C.

5% increase → 1.05; 5% decrease → 0.95.

Every 3 years → exponent t/3; monthly → 12t.

a = initial value; b = growth/decay factor.

Summary

What to remember about exponential functions指数函数要点

01 · 初值与倍率

f(t) = a · bt: a = value at t = 0; b = factor per step.

02 · 百分比转倍率

Increase p% → 1 + p/100; decrease p% → 1 − p/100; “p% more than” → 1 + p/100.

03 · 时间间隔

Exponent t/d: the factor is applied once every d units of time.

04 · 时间单位

Years to months: replace t with m/12.

05 · 识别模型

Constant difference → linear; constant percent / ratio → exponential.

06 · 30 秒自检

What is being asked? Which equation or rule applies? How can you check the result?

说清所求 → 选公式或列式 → 代回或检查单位。
